reason: cot-lint is a repository linter that detects chain-of-thought leakage and session-oriented narration in documentation, comments, JSDoc, and optionally source files, with JSON output for CI and an accompanying cleanup skill.

summaries.zh: 用于扫描代码仓库中的文档、注释和源代码，识别可能泄露思维链或会话过程的文本，并输出适用于 CI 的检查结果。
summaries.en: A repository linter that identifies chain-of-thought leakage and session-oriented narration in documentation, comments, JSDoc, and optional source files, with CI-friendly output.

capabilities: Scans repository prose and source files for chain-of-thought leakage patterns
Produces human-readable or JSON lint findings and CI exit codes
Provides an agent skill that evaluates findings and can guide repository text cleanup
